purpose: Promote Paylocity to documentation-backed specification coverage and bind payroll-processed events to two stable, complete employee-by-employee pay-statement reads without granting payroll authority.

overrides.reason: Promote the existing Paylocity HCM/payroll target using current official developer documentation while keeping partner-restricted payroll detail, employee scope, webhook delivery and every write surface separately governed.

connectionRoutes: Paylocity NextGen HTTPS APIs using OAuth 2.0 client credentials and short-lived bearer tokens
Paylocity Web Link v2 HTTPS APIs where a customer-approved legacy resource is required
HTTPS payroll-processed, employee-change, new-hire, termination and time-off webhook callbacks protected by TLS and separately configured callback authentication
Partner-restricted Pay Details endpoints only after the exact company and partnership entitlement are approved
readRoutes: GET /coreHr/v1/companies/{companyId}/employees with a maximum page size of 20 and opaque nextToken pagination
GET /apiHub/payroll/v1/companies/{companyId}/employees/{employeeId}/payStatements with check-date range, offset, limit and optional total-count evidence
GET /apiHub/time/v2/companies/{companyId}/employees/{employeeId}/punchDetails for employee-scoped work and non-work punch evidence
GET /apiHub/time/v2/companies/{companyId}/punchDetails/{resourceId} only after the asynchronous company-punch operation completes
deniedMutationRoutes: POST payroll batch creation and every payroll finalisation or recalculation action
POST punch imports, employee creation, employee updates and time-off changes
recurring earning, deduction, tax, direct-deposit or pay-rate mutation
webhook subscription or callback credential mutation outside the privileged bootstrap workflow
payroll, attendance, leave-balance or employee-master write-back
stableIdentifiers: companyId identifies a Paylocity payroll entity
employeeId is unique only within its companyId and remains an opaque source identity
payStatementId is a nonzero UUID and cannot be reassigned across employees
payroll run identity is the exact companyId plus processId plus checkDate plus runId
punch identity uses companyId plus shift start date plus punch ID as recommended by Paylocity
freshnessLatency: payroll-processed webhooks are near-real-time hints emitted when Paylocity detects all payroll processes complete
employee and payroll detail are re-read from authoritative APIs after the event
hybrid webhook plus scheduled polling is the provider-recommended recovery pattern
punch reads should wait approximately 10 to 15 minutes after shift end to reduce incomplete synchronisation
permissions: OAuth client credentials must be entitled only to the exact required read APIs and company IDs
Pay Details is partner-restricted and requires an approved Paylocity Technology Partnership Agreement
webhook callback authentication is separately revision-bound and never becomes API or payroll authority
sensitive Core HR sections are excluded unless separately approved and field-minimised
paginationDeltaWebhooks: Core HR v1 employee batches use an opaque nextToken and a maximum limit of 20
Pay Details employee/date-range reads use offset plus limit and optional total-count headers
company punch detail reads use an asynchronous resourceId followed by offset pagination
webhooks are hints rather than complete snapshots and must be reconciled to API reads
polling overlap and exact source identity prevent missed events and duplicate application
regionalApiVersions: API versions are encoded in resource URLs and must be pinned per connection
the exact demo or production HTTPS origin is discovered and bound rather than inferred
company time zone is authoritative for relative punch windows that deliberately omit time-zone suffixes
company and employee identities remain company-scoped across transfers and multi-company estates
customFields: employee custom fields and company-specific lookup values exist but require explicit field mapping and schema fingerprints
sensitive, compensation, tax, direct-deposit, work-authorisation and demographic sections are not included by default
future-dated status, department and pay changes retain their effective dates and do not become current early
rateLimits: Paylocity can return HTTP 429 and reserves the right to impose endpoint-specific limits
Punch Detail documents 300 requests per minute with a burst limit of 5 requests per second
only one company-level punch detail operation can run at once; later operations queue FIFO
backoff honours provider limits and never widens tenant, company, employee, route or date scope
failureModes: webhook delivered before all employee pay statements are consistently readable
missed or delayed webhook, callback authentication failure or a delivery path that does not retry every HTTPS error
employee roster or pay-statement pagination gap, total-count drift, duplicate page or mutable offset window
employee transfer causing company-scoped identity collision
payStatementId reassigned across employees or payload changes between reconciliation passes
401 token expiry, 403 missing entitlement, 429 throttling, 5xx provider outage or regional endpoint drift
API-version deprecation, custom-field change or sensitive-field expansion
relative-time, DST or overnight-shift misinterpretation in punch reads
reconciliation: treat payroll-processed webhook data only as a trigger keyed by companyId, processId, checkDate and runId
require a complete roster snapshot and exactly two stable employee-by-employee Pay Details passes
require gapless offset pages, constant total counts, exact roster coverage and identical statement UUID plus payload digests across both passes
pseudonymise employee identities in the authority result and return counts and evidence fingerprints rather than wage values
never advance a checkpoint or grant payroll, attendance, deletion, causal or write authority from this observation
schemaDrift: pin API URL version, employee schema, pay-statement schema, mapping and principal fingerprints
quarantine new fields, sensitive section expansion, route migration or partnership-entitlement changes until reviewed
use the Paylocity changelog and version lifecycle to prepare migrations before an endpoint is retired
retriesReconnect: refresh short-lived OAuth access tokens within the approved client identity
back off on 429 and transient 5xx responses without creating duplicate payroll reads or write attempts
recover missed events through scheduled polling and re-run both stable coverage passes
credential renewal, partnership changes and webhook callback changes require privileged evidence-bound approval
customerValueOpportunities: reconcile processed payroll coverage before presenting payroll-ready exceptions
compare scheduled, punched and paid hours without treating any one source as self-proving attendance truth
identify missing statements, unexpected zero-statement employees, duplicate identities and cost-centre mapping breaks before finance close
separate overtime caused by demand or skill constraints from payroll coding and time-capture defects
reduce support tickets by diagnosing webhook, entitlement, pagination, rate-limit and provider-outage failure domains automatically
zeroFrictionConnection: discover the company IDs and entitled read APIs after OAuth connection
propose the minimum field projection excluding sensitive Core HR sections
pre-fill the company time zone, currency, API versions and exact callback route
generate roster, pay-statement and punch mappings from provider schemas and stop for review on ambiguity
measure manual company mappings, field approvals, retries and time-to-first reconciled payroll run removed
patch.productHandoff: Show a decision-ready payroll coverage card after each processed run: employees covered, statements found, zero-statement exceptions, schedule-versus-punch-versus-paid anomalies, freshness and exact failure domain. Do not expose raw API tables or imply payroll approval.
patch.autonomyHandoff: Detect webhook gaps, expiring credentials, entitlement drift, 429 throttling, route/version changes, employee-company identity moves, unstable pagination and statement mismatches; auto-recover only by bounded token refresh, backoff and read-only polling, otherwise prepare the exact safest corrective action.

Paylocity Get Pay Statement by ID

patch.evidenceNote: Official Paylocity documentation was reviewed for authentication, versioning, employee batches, payroll-processed webhooks, Pay Details, punch details, rate limits, recovery and partnership requirements. No Paylocity sandbox, customer company, OAuth credential, webhook callback, tenant authentication, live employee or payroll read, denied write, hosted VECTOR proof or production certification is claimed.
patch.nextBuildAction: In an authorised Paylocity sandbox under an approved company and partnership entitlement, prove OAuth client credentials, enumerate exact company and read scopes, complete one roster plus two stable Pay Details passes after a payroll-processed webhook, verify empty-employee coverage and statement UUIDs, then test token expiry, callback authentication failure, missed webhook recovery, 403 entitlement loss, 429 backoff, page drift, route/version change and denial of payroll, punch and employee mutations.
